end.summary:
Identified standing, sleeping, and slanting straight lines across 5 attempts.
Used familiar examples such as a flagpole, kite string, table edge, and slide.
Distinguished curved lines from straight lines using a bangle example.
Answered 4 of 5 items without help; teach-back was not passed.
Asked several times to play a game during the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping, and slanting straight lines with Om using everyday examples. Om explained the method by linking each line to objects such as a flagpole, a sleeping person, and a slide, and also identified a bangle as curved rather than straight. One mix-up about curved lines was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Om to find and name one standing, one sleeping, and one slanting line in the room.
